title: A staff member with no role is never turned on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to a Public API sandbox organization on production as its Admin.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a staff member in that sandbox, staff member A, with no role, active, with Time Clock on and Billable set to Yes (written down with a screenshot).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, Staff.
  2. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 2:

  • Technician is off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-N2: “A staff member with no role is never turned on, whatever they meet, matching who the board offers today. In practice this only affects Public API sandbox staff.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
